description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Zantetsuken (0~2), removed after using Zantetsuken two times

description.name: Zantetsuken Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Zantetsuken level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Lightning abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning]

description.name: Zantetsuken Level
description.text: Keeps track of Zantetsuken level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning]
